title: Supply Chain Insights Builder for LLM Inference Procurement
creator: Anika Patel
description: Build an internal tool and pipeline ("Market Snapshot Builder") that synthesizes multi-source supply signals (model availability, regional latency, pricing, quantization compatibility, and provider outage history) into normalized 'supply health' indicators and exportable reports for PMs, SRE, and Sales. Purpose: accelerate decisions around default model fallbacks, procurement readiness, and Dedicated capacity provisioning by providing a weekly, queryable market snapshot tailored to Redwood inference needs.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest at least three signal sources (internal telemetry + two external feeds) and persist normalized daily metrics
UI in Console: supply health time-series and per-model regional microcards accessible to PMs and SREs
Exportable CSV/JSON report generation (weekly) for Sales and Procurement
Signal-weighting config: PMs can adjust weights and immediately see recomputed rankings
Automated alert rules: threshold-based alerts surfaced to the Market Intelligence Slack channel
tasks: Define schema for normalized supply signals (availability, avg latency p50/p95, price-per-1k tokens, quant-compatibility flag, outage-frequency)
Prototype ingestion pipeline (kinesis -> small ETL -> materialized table) to pull internal telemetry and two vendor price/availability APIs
Backend: lightweight service to compute supply health score and expose REST endpoints
Frontend: Console widget (grid view + timeseries) and report export UI
Signal-weighting UI: control panel for PMs to set weights and store presets
Alerting rules engine and Slack integration (market-intel channel)
risks: External vendor APIs may rate-limit or change schema unexpectedly
Normalization assumptions may bias scores — requires validation with field teams
Frontend changes may compete with Console roadmap timing
notes: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with SRE (Jia Chen) and Sales Ops (Rosa Martinez). Agreed minimum viable signals: regional availability, p95 latency, price point, outage count.

2026-03-04: Engineering feasibility review — suggested approach: daily batch ETL into BigQuery and a small service layer for scoring. ENG prefers weekly cadence for external vendor polling to avoid rate limits.
2026-03-06: Design sync — agreed microcard layout and color semantics for 'supply health' (green/yellow/red). Drive: https://drive.redwood.example.com/market-snapshot-proto
2026-03-09: PM review — set initial weight defaults (availability 40%, latency 30%, price 20%, outage-frequency 10%). Action: run backtest on Jan–Feb telemetry to sanity-check rankings.
Links: Confluence spec https://confluence.redwood.example.com/display/MI/Market+Snapshot+Builder; GH prototype PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/market-snapshot/pull/12
open_questions: Which external vendors should we prioritize for the first feed? (vendor pricing+availability only vs full telemetry)
How frequently should weights be audited and who owns the audit (PM or Market Intelligence lead)?
Should snapshot reports include recommended fallback model mappings or only raw/normalized signals?
next_steps: By 2026-03-12: Eng to deliver ETL spike and sample materialized table schema
By 2026-03-15: Run backtest and produce initial ranked list of top-10 models by supply-health
By 2026-03-18: UX to deliver Console widget mock (high-fidelity) and export interactions
Schedule: Weekly sync (Market Intelligence, SRE, Sales Ops) on Fridays 11:00 PT
